if expected and type(value) not in [_SCHEMA_TYPES[t] for t in (
            expected if isinstance(expected, list) else [expected])]:
evidence.reason: schema_problem() is documented to fail closed with a diagnostic, but it indexes _SCHEMA_TYPES for every type name in the schema. A standard JSON Schema type such as "number" is not in _SCHEMA_TYPES, so the comprehension raises KeyError instead of returning an unsupported-type violation. That exception is not converted into a receipt verdict, so the finding correctly identifies a routine correctness defect in existing intended behavior.
